description: VMware ESXi 单机视图（vmware-exporter 当前指标命名 · VictoriaMetrics）：CPU/内存用量与调度健康、网络、数据存储 I/O、本机虚拟机与挂载存储清单、Exporter 自监控。

targets.expr: count(vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"} and on(vcenter, vmmo) vmware_vm_power_state{state="poweredOn"})

sum((vmware_vm_cpu_corecount{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(vcenter, vmmo) vmware_vm_power_state{state="poweredOn"}) * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"}) / vmware_host_cpu_threadcount{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"}

sum((vmware_vm_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(vcenter, vmmo) vmware_vm_power_state{state="poweredOn"}) * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"}) / vmware_host_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"}

panels.title: CPU 使用率 / 调度延迟
CPU 使用量 vs 需求
Top $top 虚拟机 · CPU（本主机）

targets.expr: topk_avg($top, max by(vm) (vmware_vm_cpu_usage_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"}))

panels.title: Top $top 虚拟机 · 活跃内存（本主机）

targets.expr: topk_avg($top, max by(vm) (vmware_vm_mem_active_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"}))

panels.title: Top $top 虚拟机 · 已用内存（本主机）

targets.expr: topk_avg($top, max by(vm) (vmware_vm_mem_consumed_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"}))

panels.title: 网络吞吐（按网卡，↓接收 / ↑发送）
数据存储延迟（按存储，↓读 / ↑写）
本机虚拟机清单 · Virtual Machines

targets.expr: max by(vmmo) (vmware_vm_cpu_corecount{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})
max by(vmmo) (vmware_vm_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})
max by(vmmo) (vmware_vm_cpu_usage_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})
max by(vmmo) (vmware_vm_mem_active_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})
max by(vmmo) (vmware_vm_sys_uptime_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on (vmmo) group_left vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})

panels.title: 挂载数据存储 · Attached Datastores

targets.expr: max by(pfinstance, ds, type) (vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(pfinstance) vmware_host_datastore_read_operations{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})

max by(pfinstance) (vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on(dsmo) group_left(pfinstance) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(pfinstance) vmware_host_datastore_read_operations{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})

max by(pfinstance) (vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on(dsmo) group_left(pfinstance) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(pfinstance) vmware_host_datastore_read_operations{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})

max by(pfinstance) ((vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} - vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"}) / vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * 100 * on(dsmo) group_left(pfinstance) vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(pfinstance) vmware_host_datastore_read_operations{vcenter=~"$vcenter", hostmo=~"$hostmo"})

panels.title: 各采集器成功状态 (1=成功)
生命周期与健康 · Lifecycle & Health
本机关机 VM · Powered Off

targets.expr: count(vmware_vm_power_state{vcenter=~"$vcenter",state="poweredOff"} * on(vcenter, vmmo) group_left(hostmo) max by(vcenter, vmmo, hostmo)(vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"}))
count(vmware_vm_power_state{vcenter=~"$vcenter",state="suspended"} * on(vcenter, vmmo) group_left(hostmo) max by(vcenter, vmmo, hostmo)(vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"}))

panels.title: 本机 VM 电源状态分布

targets.expr: count by(state)(vmware_vm_power_state{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on(vcenter, vmmo) group_left(hostmo) max by(vcenter, vmmo, hostmo)(vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"}))
